fade.description: Length of the edge fade in px. 0 turns the fades off.

scrollbars.description: "auto" shows scrollbars while scrolling or hovering; "always" keeps them visible when content overflows.

hideDelay.description: How long scrollbars linger after scrolling stops, in ms.

maxHeight.description: Maximum viewport height, for vertical areas that grow with their content.

snap.description: Passed to the viewport's scroll-snap-type, for example "x mandatory". Children set their own scroll-snap-align.

label.description: Accessible name. The viewport becomes a labelled region.

wheelToHorizontal.description: Turns vertical wheel movement into horizontal scrolling for horizontal areas.

viewportClassName.description: Extra class on the scrolling viewport.

viewportRef.description: The scrolling element, for programmatic scrolling.

onEdgeChange.description: Called when content starts or stops extending past an edge: { top, bottom, left, right }.
